faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about AI Image Generator

items.question: How many credits does generating an image cost?
items.answer: Each image generation costs 1–4 credits depending on the model and resolution you choose. You can check the exact cost before generating.

items.question: What image formats and resolutions are supported?
items.answer: We support JPEG and PNG output. You can choose aspect ratios including 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, and 3:4, rendered at high resolution.

items.question: Can I use a reference image for generation?
items.answer: Yes. Upload one or more reference images to guide style, composition, or character consistency. Our models support both text-to-image and image-to-image modes.

items.question: How long does image generation take?
items.answer: Most images are generated within 10–30 seconds depending on the model selected and current server load.

items.question: Can I use generated images for commercial purposes?
items.answer: Yes. You retain the rights to use generated images for commercial projects, provided you comply with our Terms of Service and the underlying model's usage policies.

items.question: What happens if generation fails?
items.answer: If a generation fails due to a server error, your credits are automatically refunded. You can retry anytime without losing credits.
